##### Project general facts

Haus 99 by Hausen Developments, rises as a boutique low‑rise tower whose contemporary silhouette. Conceived as a private collection of residences, it combines a low-rise contemporary silhouette with soft curved lines and full-height glass facades that draw natural light deep into the interiors and open dual-aspect views over the surrounding parkland.

The amenity programme spans a spectacular rooftop deck crowned by an infinity pool, a children’s splash zone, an open‑air cinema, a barbecue pavilion and a running track for outdoor exercise. At podium level, a thoughtfully landscaped garden houses an indoor gym, an outdoor gym, a dedicated yoga deck, a children’s play area and a sunken fire‑pit lounge that encourages relaxed gatherings. A double‑height lobby greets residents, while underground levels provide secure parking.

Interiors are presented with modern finishing with high‑quality materials, ensuring a cohesive aesthetic throughout each home. The residential mix covers studios, one-bedroom apartments, one-bedroom apartments with a flexible sunroom, two-bedroom apartments including layouts with a maid's room, and a limited series of three- and four-bedroom duplexes and townhouses with maid's rooms. The sunroom can serve as a home office, reading corner, nursery or guest space, while the townhouses offer private terraces and direct access to the podium gardens, bringing a villa-style way of living into a managed building.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Triangle is an established low-density community known for leafy streets, numerous manicured parks, tree-lined avenues, pet-friendly green spaces, and neighbourhood tennis and padel courts. Its quiet, low-rise residential character suits families and professionals looking for a calm, green setting that still stays well connected to the rest of the city, with jogging routes and outdoor recreation close at hand.

The address sits close to Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, giving fast access to the main business and leisure districts of Dubai. Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, Mall of the Emirates and Downtown Dubai are within a short drive, and both Al Maktoum International Airport and Dubai International Airport are easily reachable by car.

Everyday needs are covered nearby, including Sunmarke School, Mediclinic healthcare and a range of neighbourhood shops, cafes and community facilities. The planned Skylight Mall within Jumeirah Village Triangle is set to add a large retail, dining, wellness and entertainment destination to the neighbourhood, further strengthening the appeal of the area for both end users and investors.
